name: Cable Hip Abduction
steps: Stand sideways to a low pulley with its cuff on the ankle farther from the machine.
Lift the cuffed leg out to the side against the cable.
Lower your foot under control until it is beneath your hip.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your toes forward and your hips level.
Avoid leaning your torso sideways to lift the leg higher.
